task.specification: Validate provider project_markers as nonempty normalized relative marker paths: reject absolute paths, parent traversal, backslashes, NUL, and duplicate entries while preserving the packaged example configuration.
task.candidate_inline_tests_policy: Candidate-authored tests are admissible only when contained in the allowlisted src/config.rs bytes and are not acceptance evidence.

baseline_control.expected_result: The frozen test binary must launch and run all 14 tests. Exactly the 11 named negative tests fail through runtime assertions because frozen Config validation accepts the forbidden markers; exactly the 3 named positive controls pass; 0 tests are ignored or filtered out; the command exits nonzero.

candidate_acceptance.trusted_probe_expectation: All 14 named trusted tests actually run and pass against a fresh candidate validation checkout containing only audited src/config.rs candidate bytes.

focused_regression_target.expectation: All 4 frozen config_privacy integration tests actually run and pass.

named_tests.name: rejects_empty_project_marker_entries
named_tests.rationale: Nonempty constrains each declared marker entry; an absent marker list remains valid.

named_tests.name: rejects_unix_absolute_project_markers
named_tests.rationale: Leading-slash paths are absolute and cannot be workspace-relative marker identities.

named_tests.name: rejects_windows_drive_rooted_project_markers
named_tests.rationale: Drive-rooted spellings must fail on every host, including both slash conventions.

named_tests.name: rejects_windows_unc_project_markers
named_tests.rationale: UNC spellings identify rooted network paths and must fail independently of the validation host.

named_tests.name: rejects_parent_traversal_at_beginning_or_interior
named_tests.rationale: Every '..' component is forbidden, whether it appears first or inside a longer marker.

named_tests.name: rejects_backslashes_in_relative_project_markers
named_tests.rationale: Canonical relative marker syntax uses forward slashes; backslashes are not normalized.

named_tests.name: rejects_nul_project_markers_after_public_parse
named_tests.rationale: A valid TOML Config is parsed first and then publicly mutated before validate(), proving semantic NUL rejection rather than TOML syntax rejection.

named_tests.name: rejects_duplicate_project_markers_within_one_provider
named_tests.rationale: A nonadjacent repeated marker proves list-local duplicate detection without relying on adjacency.

named_tests.name: rejects_current_directory_path_components
named_tests.rationale: Normalized markers contain no '.' components, including a marker consisting only of '.'.

named_tests.name: rejects_repeated_or_trailing_forward_slashes
named_tests.rationale: Repeated and trailing slashes create empty path components and are not normalized spellings.

named_tests.name: rejects_invalid_markers_in_disabled_provider_entries
named_tests.rationale: Config semantics apply to every provider entry; disabled state defers execution but does not exempt malformed configuration.

named_tests.name: valid_markers_across_enabled_and_disabled_providers_preserve_order
named_tests.rationale: Distinct normalized markers remain byte-exact and ordered across enabled and disabled entries; ordinary Unicode and interior spaces remain data.

named_tests.name: nonexistent_normalized_project_marker_is_accepted_during_validation
named_tests.rationale: Marker existence belongs to provider scope discovery and must not be imposed by Config validation.

named_tests.name: packaged_example_configuration_parses_with_marker_order_preserved
named_tests.rationale: The compile-time included packaged example is the compatibility control and its TypeScript and Rust marker order remains unchanged.

ambiguities_resolved.topic: empty marker list versus empty marker entry
ambiguities_resolved.decision: An empty project_markers list remains valid; every entry present in a list must be nonempty.
ambiguities_resolved.basis: The packaged configuration contains providers with no project_markers, while the task specifies nonempty marker paths.

ambiguities_resolved.decision: Duplicates are rejected within each ProviderConfigEntry.project_markers list; no global cross-provider uniqueness contract is introduced.
ambiguities_resolved.basis: Each provider owns an ordered marker declaration and the task does not define cross-provider identity.

ambiguities_resolved.decision: Ordinary Unicode and interior ASCII spaces remain byte-preserved data; leading or trailing spaces are not added to this validator contract.
ambiguities_resolved.basis: The task names path normalization hazards but supplies no public contract requiring trimming.

ambiguities_resolved.decision: Unix absolute, Windows drive-rooted, and Windows UNC spellings are rejected on every validation host.
ambiguities_resolved.basis: Configuration portability requires host-independent rejection of every explicitly forbidden absolute spelling.

ambiguities_resolved.decision: Marker validation applies to disabled as well as enabled provider entries.
ambiguities_resolved.basis: Enabled state controls execution; it does not make malformed persisted configuration valid.

ambiguities_resolved.decision: Config validation accepts normalized nonexistent marker paths.
ambiguities_resolved.basis: The corpus explicitly assigns existence checks to provider scope discovery.

ambiguities_resolved.decision: Trusted marker tests use builtin providers and impose no command, version, resolution, or shell-policy behavior.
ambiguities_resolved.basis: Those behaviors are explicitly outside this task.
